# OpenAPI specification schemas

The official JSON Schemas of the OpenAPI Specification, used by
`tests/helpers/openapi-validate.ts` to validate the documents the Contract
Compiler generates (P1.3). Copied unmodified from spec.openapis.org; the
Specification and these schemas are licensed under the Apache License 2.0 by
the OpenAPI Initiative.
